title: Telemetry handshake proxy and request-metadata sentinel
creator: Ethan Ramirez
description: Implement a lightweight 'metadata sentinel' and an accompanying telemetry-handshake proxy for SDKs and edge middleware. The sentinel will normalize request provenance (request id, tenant id, route fingerprint, sampling hint) into a compact, signed envelope carried in a single header (X-RW-META) and supported by SDK middleware adapters for Node/Python/Go. The handshake proxy provides backward-compatible translation for legacy clients and performs cheap validation/signature checks to avoid expensive crypto on hot paths.
acceptance_criteria: SDK middleware injects X-RW-META header < 200 bytes for typical requests
Sentinel supports opaque signing with key rotation and validates on the edge before span creation
Latency overhead < 0.6ms p50 for common request path (measured in synthetic microbenchmarks)
Fall-back path for older clients (X-RW-REQ / X-RW-TRACE) via handshake proxy works with no loss of request id
Automated tests and end-to-end perf suite added to infra repo; rollout runbook documented
notes: Design aligns with runtime prefix/KV caching goals: make provenance cheap to compute and cacheable per-client
Tradeoffs considered: canonical JSON header vs compact binary; picked CBOR-like compactness with base64 envelope to reduce header length and parsing cost
We will use HMAC-SHA256 with short-lived signing keys managed via KMS for the initial rollout. Asymmetric signatures deferred due to CPU cost on edge proxies
Edge proxies will validate signature and enrich request context with de-serialized fields for tracing hooks to consume
rollout_plan: 1) Merge SDK adapters behind feature flag; publish canary SDK
2) Deploy handshake proxy in staging region; enable translation for legacy headers
3) Run 48h canary with increased sampling and perf monitoring
4) Gradual rollout to 25/50/100% with automatic disable if error rate or p99 latency regresses
test_plan: Unit tests for serializer/validator to guarantee deterministic ordering of fields
Integration tests between SDK adapter and edge proxy verifying canonicalization
Perf harness measuring p50/p90/p99 overhead across sequence lengths and batching configurations
Chaos test: intentionally corrupt header to ensure graceful rejection and fallbacks
implementation_tasks: SDK: implement middleware adapter for Node (Aisha) + Python (Connor)
Edge: handshake proxy translation + validation layer (María)
Runtime: update tracing hooks to consume enriched context instead of multiple headers (Ethan)
Infra: deploy key-rotation job and metrics for signature verification failures (SRE)
blockers: KMS quota for generating short-lived signing keys in staging (ticket opened with Cloud team)
Need final API decision on whether to include route-level sample_hint (affects header size)
security_considerations: Envelope contains tenant id — encryption in transit required (TLS already enforced)
Do not include any PII in the envelope; policy enforced by serializer tests
Key rotation window and replay mitigation: include issued_at and nonce; proxies reject envelopes older than 2 minutes by default
